text: きのみクラッシュで　くだいて　できた　きのみの　こなを　いれる　ほぞんようの　びん。

structure.jp: きのみクラッシュで　くだいて　できた　きのみの　こなを　いれる
structure.en: for putting in the Berry powder made by crushing in Berry Crush

structure.jp: ほぞんようの　びん。

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: くだいて　できた　きのみの　こな
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in an action word placed right before a thing describes that thing. The whole first part then describes the jar the same way. くだいて　できた　きのみの　こな = 'Berry powder made by crushing'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て ending joins two actions, and here the first is how the second came about. くだいて　できた = 'crushed and so made'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で shows the means used to do something. きのみクラッシュで = 'by means of Berry Crush'.
